definition: In this social-context source, pseudo- means something presented as if it belongs to a legitimate category when it does not fully or genuinely do so. For example, a pseudo-investment scheme appears investment-like but is described as part of overlapping online gambling, casino, and pyramidal scheme environments rather than as a standard investment activity.
